judge_separation.requirement: The semantic judge must not share the critic's model: a named human reviewer judges every semantic item, or a judge from a different provider does, with identity recorded.
excluded_as_judge: any model or session with repository access, and any model of the critic's family
judge_separation.how_established_becomes_true: Only in a successor profile file, frozen and committed before sealing, that names design q01-release-v3 and records the judge's identity, the option chosen and the exclusions above; its path and sha256 enter the pre-dispatch manifest and the harness checks them. Never set in place.

currently_available.consequence: release-v3 cannot execute until a separate judge is arranged in a successor profile

v3_error_independence.why: verification.md section 6 requires, on the same model, item-level linking of generation-path errors and independent-reconstruction-path critic errors, with task/error scope, baseline critic, joint-error criteria, sample size and precision, confounders, analysis method and stop/exclusion rules fixed before sealed data is seen. This profile fixes the scope below but not the tolerated joint-failure level or the required precision, because no risk-based tolerance has been set by the owner.

fixed_now.task_and_error_scope: Q01-family critic judgments on design candidates: criteria Q1-Q8 and the six boundary classes
fixed_now.comparison_baseline: the same critic configuration with no lens set
fixed_now.joint_error_definition: an item where the generation path's output has the defect and the critic misses it on the same item, and, separately, an item without the defect that the critic rejects; the two never share a denominator
known_confounders: shared model and training data between generator and critic
materials authored in one project style
fixed_now.analysis: descriptive counts with real denominators; a confidence interval only when its sample and dependence assumptions hold, otherwise counts and limits only

v3_error_independence.stop_and_exclusion: exclusions only before the first dispatch, with the reason recorded; after the first dispatch a disputed case makes the suite incomplete

metric_labels.joint_error: a generation-path defect missed by the critic on the same item (a V3 metric; needs a generation path, which release-v3 does not have)
metric_labels.judge_disagreement: a judge verdict differing from the sealed expectation (reported, never a joint error)

v3_error_independence.becomes_verified: only in a later frozen profile version that fixes the owner-set tolerated joint-failure level, sample size and precision, and a run that meets them

not_claimed: a universal independence threshold or score
that a separate judge makes errors statistically independent
